g.text: The chariot: fill to 30 kg, then empty, then fill again
Real run of ConvoyeurDemo: 5 loaders, 5 unloaders, Chariot(30 kg, 10 items). Stock: 7 9 7 8 4 10 6 10 6 4
The whole run, trip by trip
stock empty, last loader calls setFull()
Red dashed line = 30 kg. A refused item goes back to the stock and rides the next trip.
